title: Linearity of the normalized coefficient restriction comparison
statement: Let B, eR, G and hG be as in [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding]. For h:S→T and a module-valued pro-etale sheaf N on S, let M=h_* E_S(N), P=E_T(h_*N), and let e:M.X≅P.X be the additive isomorphism obtained by restricting the underlying-sheaf encoding isomorphism at S and composing with its inverse at T. Then act_M followed by e.hom equals Λ_T acting on e.hom followed by act_P, where Λ_T is the pullback of the continuous-function condensed ring. Thus this particular additive isomorphism is linear.

proof.text: Reuse the existing encodingPushforwardIso and push_action through a proof-only import all Sheaf.Paper.FiniteDiscreteRestrictionEncoding. These proved constructions give the sectionwise inverse-encoding pushforward comparison, including its scalar action compatibility.

The existing encodingPushforwardIso is assembled by applying the single functor G to sectionwise identity isomorphisms of internal modules. The equality hG supplies a natural forgetful comparison; its naturality on those identity isomorphisms shows that the underlying pushforward comparison commutes with the forgetful comparison.

Using the counit of restriction of scalars along the scheme-ring isomorphism, whose underlying map is the identity, and naturality of sheafEncodingForgetIso, identify the normalized coefficient forget isomorphism with the inverse forgetful comparison followed by the inverse equivalence unit.

For N, compose the sectionwise pushforward isomorphism with the restrictions of the inverse unit at N and the unit at h_*N. Fullness of E_T.inverse lifts this composite to a module morphism q. Naturality of the forgetful comparison, the preceding two compatibility equalities, and cancellation of the two unit components show that q.hom is exactly the prescribed normalized additive restriction comparison. Apply Mod.act_hom to q.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionForgetIso_linear
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) (N : FiniteDiscreteProEtaleSheaves B S) :
    let M := (lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) h).obj
      ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG S).functor.obj N)
    let P := (finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).functor.obj
      ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) h).obj N)
    let e := (finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionForgetIso B eR G hG h).app N
    Mod.act M.X ≫ e.hom = (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) T) ◁
      e.hom ≫ Mod.act P.X
